description: This file defines an abstract class 'Finder' used within the Apache OFBiz framework for entity finding operations. It manages entity name expansion, cache usage configuration, and declares an abstract method for executing find operations.

classes.name: Finder
classes.description: An abstract class for entity finding operations, providing mechanisms for entity name expansion and cache control.

methods.name: getEntityNameExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander object for entity name.

methods.name: getUseCacheStrExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander object indicating cache usage.

methods.name: setEntityName
methods.description: Sets the entity name and updates the entityNameExdr accordingly.

methods.name: runFind
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the find operation given a context and delegator.
